name: canvas-spatial-whiteboarding
description: Provides methodologies and spatial design frameworks for infinite canvas whiteboarding, visual research, exploratory mapping, and strategic analysis. Covers spatial information architecture, 2x2 competitive positioning matrices, customer journey maps, service blueprints, affinity clustering, wireframe decision trees, and collaborative multiplayer board hygiene. Use when researching competitors, mapping user workflows, conducting design sprints, synthesizing requirements, or structuring unstructured discovery onto a visual canvas.
